text:
Nina (PM): quick sync  need to lock the scope for the "headroom banking" approach on dedicated pools. customers want predictable burst without surprise infra churn.
Omar (Eng): my outline: headroom banking = small reserved + an escrowed burst ledger that is time-windowed. key knobs: escrow_window_min, escrow_tokens, spill_policy.
Rory (Sales): customers like the escrow model if we provide clear terms: when escrow is consumed, either throttle or bill. many prefer throttle by default.
Fel (SRE): operational constraints: escrow must expire deterministically and be reclaimable without heavy locking. suggest background reclaim + optimistic admission checks. also need a manual "drain escrow" console action.
Hana (Billing): export requirements: we need escrow_window_id, escrow_used and billing_flag. also mapping to invoice line-items for one-off purchases.
Omar (Eng): API sketch:
PUT /v1/tenants/:id/headroom
{
  "reserved_tokens": 1000000,
  "escrow": {"tokens": 200000, "window_min": 120},
  "spill_policy": "same-tier-only",   # off | same-tier-only | permissive
  "overflow_action": "throttle"     # throttle | bill
}

Fel (SRE): rollout safety: default overflow_action = throttle. add per-tenant circuit-breaker and a short hysteresis window on autoscale to avoid oscillation.
Nina (PM): launch checklist: API + console to set headroom, escrow purchase flow, billing export columns, revoke/drain action, e2e replay flood tests. must include example contract snippet for escrow windows.
Rory (Sales): i'll draft contract language and example invoices. customers want an "emergency spillover opt-in" checkbox for events; we should mark it beta.
Hana (Billing): note: if overflow_action=bill, we need near-realtime metering to avoid surprise invoices. prefer to ship throttle-only for GA.
Omar (Eng): implementation notes: admission will atomically decrement reserved first, then escrow. escrow rows will be TTL'd and reclaimed by job. avoid full table scans by using indexed active_windows table.
Fel (SRE): monitoring + alerts: alert when a tenant hits escrow >3x/week, and when drain action used >2x/day. add a revoke audit trail.
Nina (PM): decisions: MVP = headroom banking with escrow windows, default throttle, same-tier spill only, console drain + billing exports. opt-in paid overflow and permissive spill to follow.
lifecycle-bot: RFC opened DCR-5120: "headroom-banking MVP: escrow windows + throttle default" linked to roadmap.
Nina (PM): thanks — Omar & Fel to carve tasks for next sprint, Rory/Hana to prep external docs. we'll revisit timeline after sprint planning. :thumbsup:
